monte_carlo.interpretation: A large Monte Carlo p-value means the measured spectrum is indistinguishable from a Lambda CDM realisation. A small p-value would indicate a genuine deviation.

injection_recovery.feature: Gaussian bump at k = 0.05 h/Mpc, width 0.01 h/Mpc
injection_recovery.conclusion: The pipeline detects an injected 46.4% feature at 5.0 sigma. Features at least this large would have been found, so the absence of such a feature is informative.

data_origin: COSMOS clustered Lambda CDM mock (no real survey data available)
